title: Four Stars
text: Four Stars. Attractive holder for my lovely new stone coasters..

product_metadata.title: Thirstystone Bronze Cast Iron Scroll Round Coaster Holder 5.13” Diameter Holds 4-4” to 4.25” Round Coasters
features: MATERIAL- Iron coaster holders are constructed of cast iron, which is durable and easy to maintain. This Coaster Holder perches on ball feet.
MEASURES- Coaster Holder measures 5.13” x 5.13” x 2.25”. Coaster Holder is lightweight and compact and includes felt on the bottom of each foot to protect your surfaces from scratches.
CAPACITY: Bronze Cast Iron coaster holder will hold a set of 4-4” to 4.25” round coasters. Works great for Stone, Cork, Ceramic, or Sandstone Coasters.
DESIGN- Iron coaster holder is designed to complement any room. Coaster Holder is finished in an attractive bronze color.
FUNCTIONALITY- Coaster holders are designed to keep coasters organized, easily accessible, and prevent them from being misplaced. Easily wipes clean with a damp cloth or sponge.
description: Thirstystone Bronze Cast Iron Scroll Coaster Holder is constructed of iron then finished in an attractive bronze colored finish. Designed to hold and organize a set of 4” to 4.25” round coasters. Coaster Holder will hold a set of 4. Designed to keep coasters organized, easily accessible, and prevent them from being misplaced. Coaster Holder measures 5.13” x 5.13” x 2.25”.
